pack.name: GCP Landing Zone / Resource Hierarchy
pack.description: Org/folder/project hierarchy, Shared VPC, and VPC Service Controls themes. Thematic mapping only; not certification.

rules.title: Organization folder and project hierarchy documented
rules.description: Platform scope should describe how projects roll up through folders (security, infrastructure, workloads) so org-policy inheritance and access boundaries are reviewable.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document hierarchy intent in governance.PolicyConstraints; cite organization and project scope from gcpExtractor.manifest when inventory is present.

rules.title: Project vending and workload placement explained
rules.description: Each workload project should have a documented purpose, environment class, and owning team when landing-zone project factory or folder standards are in scope.
rules.remediationGuidance: Mirror project purpose in metadata.ChangeDescription and governance.ComplianceTags; align services[].Tags with environment and cost-center keys.

rules.title: Shared VPC hub-spoke topology described
rules.description: Connectivity between host and service projects (Shared VPC attachments, Cloud NAT, and firewall rules) must be understandable from architecture relationships and governance narrative.
rules.remediationGuidance: Model hub/spoke edges in relationships with AuthenticatesWith/ReadsFrom semantics where applicable; document Shared VPC attachments in governance.PolicyConstraints.

rules.title: Org policies and VPC Service Controls alignment stated
rules.description: When org-policy exports or governance metadata reference guardrails or VPC Service Controls perimeters, non-compliance themes should be dispositioned or risk-accepted with traceable narrative.
rules.remediationGuidance: Summarize org-policy and VPC-SC gaps in governance.PolicyConstraints; tie project scope to reviewer sign-off in metadata.DecisionTraceIds.

frameworkMappings.designArea: Governance — Org policies and VPC Service Controls

rules.title: Platform identity baseline (Cloud IAM) documented
rules.description: Landing-zone identity posture should describe privileged access, break-glass, and workload identity patterns (Workload Identity Federation over downloadable service-account keys).
rules.remediationGuidance: Encode identity commitments in governance.RequiredControls; tag platform services with identity:* keys on services[].Tags.

frameworkMappings.designArea: Identity — Cloud IAM and workload identity

rules.title: Centralized logging and monitoring landing zone
rules.description: Audit, platform, and workload logs from host and service projects should converge to a documented centralized logging bucket, Pub/Sub sink, or BigQuery dataset.
rules.remediationGuidance: Declare observability sink ownership in governance.PolicyConstraints; reference gcpExtractor.manifest.CollectionTimestamp when audit exports accompany the package.

rules.title: Cloud DNS private zones and Private Service Connect
rules.description: Private DNS zones and Private Service Connect endpoints for Google-managed services should be documented when landing-zone standards require private connectivity.
rules.remediationGuidance: Set PrivateEndpointRequired on sensitive datastores[]; document DNS and PSC linkage in relationships and governance.PolicyConstraints.

rules.title: Security Command Center posture referenced
rules.description: Platform security baseline should mention Security Command Center sources and posture themes when regulated workloads are in scope.
rules.remediationGuidance: Capture SCC commitments in governance.ComplianceTags and governance.RequiredControls.

rules.title: Mandatory resource labeling for FinOps allocation
rules.description: Landing-zone labeling standards (environment, cost center, owner) should be visible on manifest services and reflected in GCP inventory when exported.
rules.remediationGuidance: Audit services[].Tags and governance.ComplianceTags against mandatory label policy; correlate with gcpExtractor inventory label columns when available.

rules.title: Segregation of duties for platform operations
rules.description: Platform team roles (network, security, identity, workload) should show separation in governance metadata when SOX or regulated controls apply.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document RACI or SoD statements in governance.PolicyConstraints and governance.RequiredControls.

rules.title: Shared services project boundaries
rules.description: Shared services (Cloud Firewall, Cloud DNS, bastion, Artifact Registry) should declare which project hosts them and how spoke workloads consume them.
rules.remediationGuidance: Describe shared-service placement in governance.PolicyConstraints; link consuming workloads via relationships.

rules.title: Evidence freshness for landing-zone reviews
rules.description: Reviews citing GCP inventory must record collection timestamp and extractor switches so landing-zone drift is auditable.
rules.remediationGuidance: Cite gcpExtractor.manifest.CollectionTimestamp, SchemaVersion, and SwitchesUsed in metadata.ChangeDescription.
